title: Statistical Network Analysis for LLMs via Knowledge Graphs
description: With Lin Tang, Xuezhou Zhang, Xiaowei Yu, and Huimin Cheng. A statistical network lens on the knowledge graphs that large language models build and rely on — measuring their structure to understand and improve them.

title: A Human-in-the-Loop LLM Framework for Trustworthy Diabetes–Nutrition Knowledge Graph
description: With Lin Tang, Xuezhou Zhang, and Huimin Cheng. Keeping humans in the loop so an LLM-built nutrition knowledge graph stays trustworthy enough for diabetes-care questions.

title: Alcohol & the Epigenetic Clock — Alcohol–CpG Aging
description: Advised by Prof. Chunyu Liu, BU Biostatistics. Does drinking show up in how fast our DNA-methylation clocks tick? Regression and mixed-effects models quantify alcohol-related epigenetic age acceleration.

title: Biomedical Q&A Agent — Graph-RAG + LLM
description: Advised by Prof. Huimin Cheng. Community-detection methods that strengthen knowledge-graph construction, powering a biomedical question-answering agent.

title: Spatially Variable Genes (SVG) Detection
description: With Prof. Shariq Mohammed, BU School of Public Health. A detection algorithm for spatially variable genes with higher accuracy and clearer interpretability than the current benchmark. Paper-level work, paused — a matter of time, not interest.

title: GNPC Hypergraph Modeling for Alzheimer's Subtypes
description: With Prof. Selena Wang, Indiana University. Hypergraph models over Global Neurodegeneration Proteomics Consortium data to capture higher-order proteomic interactions and identify clinically meaningful Alzheimer's disease subtypes. Paused mid-flight, waiting for time.
